[SWS_DM_00278] Cancellation of a Diagnostic Conversation in case of Internal
Processing
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04167
⌈
On Cancellation of a
Diagnostic Conversation
in case a diagnostic request
is currently processed in context of this protocol internally within the
Diagnostic
Server instance
, the
Diagnostic Server instance
shall abort the started
activity as far as possible.
⌋
